# Isolated private helper build; never deploys. Pass the exact retained upstream
# NVAPI shim for the CPU regression. No ZLUDA driver or real GPU is used by it.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(TRPAmdNvapiAdapter LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
add_library(TRPAmdNvapiAdapter SHARED nvapi_adapter.cpp)
set_target_properties(TRPAmdNvapiAdapter PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME nvapi64)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(TRPAmdNvapiAdapter PRIVATE /Zi)
    target_link_options(TRPAmdNvapiAdapter PRIVATE /DEBUG /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF)
endif()
if(TRP_NVAPI_UPSTREAM)
    enable_testing()
    add_library(TRPFakeCuda SHARED ../../tests/AmdNvapiFakeCuda.cpp)
    set_target_properties(TRPFakeCuda PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME nvcuda)
    add_executable(TRPAmdNvapiAdapterTests ../../tests/AmdNvapiAdapterTests.cpp)
    add_dependencies(TRPAmdNvapiAdapterTests TRPAmdNvapiAdapter TRPFakeCuda)
    add_custom_command(TARGET TRPAmdNvapiAdapterTests POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${TRP_NVAPI_UPSTREAM}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:TRPAmdNvapiAdapterTests>/nvapi_trp_upstream.dll")
    add_test(NAME AMDNvapiSelectedAdapter COMMAND TRPAmdNvapiAdapterTests)
    add_library(TRPFakeHip SHARED ../../tests/AmdHipDiagnosticsFake.cpp)
    set_target_properties(TRPFakeHip PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME amdhip64_7)
    add_executable(TRPAmdHipDiagnosticsTests ../../tests/AmdHipDiagnosticsTests.cpp)
    add_dependencies(TRPAmdHipDiagnosticsTests TRPFakeHip)
    add_test(NAME AMDHipObserver COMMAND TRPAmdHipDiagnosticsTests)
endif()
